annotations.title: Mint or get a canonical object identity

attester.description: ed25519 binding, verified. Omit it and the refusal's details.how_to_sign gives the digest to sign.

cell.description: cell64 to anchor the object directly (no geocode).

external_ids.description: Stable ids that drive convergence. Caller-supplied values win over geocoder-derived ones.

kind.description: Object class: bridge, river, farm_plot, building, admin_division, place, custom, ... Defaults to "place".

label.description: Human name of the object, e.g. "Golden Gate Bridge", "the north dam". Required.

lat.description: Latitude anchoring the object to a place, paired with lng. The identity is hashed from this anchor, so two agents anchoring the same object differently mint different entities.

place.description: Free-text place to anchor the object (geocoded). Provide place OR cell OR lat+lng.

name: emem_entity
title: Mint or get a canonical object identity
